name: Sled Dog
text: You may include up to 4 copies of Sled Dog in your deck. Up to 2 Sled Dog cards take up a single ally slot. [action] Exhaust X Sled Dogs: Move. Move X times. [action] Exhaust X Sled Dogs: Fight. You get +X [combat] for this attack. Instead of its standard damage, this attack deals X damage.
text_cn: 你的牌组里可以有最多4张雪橇犬。一个盟友槽位可以有最多2张雪橇犬卡牌。 [action]消耗X张雪橇犬：移动。移动X次。 [action]消耗X张雪橇犬：攻击。你这次攻击+X[combat]。这次攻击不造成基础伤害，改为造成X点伤害。
